scope: Additive source-only offline art checkpoint. No product code, repository history rewrite, merge, Site publication or deployment.

status.retained_full_frame: Native 900x600 frame, 512 samples, actually rendered, visually reviewed and delivered from the retained master
status.retained_motion: 75 independently rendered deformed-geometry frames, 128 samples/frame, native 100x72 rim crop, 2.5 seconds at 30 fps playback, actually rendered and reviewed as a bounded offline proof
status.public_adaptations: AST/hash/source-helper/command-plan checks only. Public adapted Blender/OIDN/encoding scripts have not been executed.

external_master.delivery: Owner-held exact packed input, omitted from Git; no public download URL
external_master.rebuild: This bundle starts from the exact saved master. It is not an independently reconstructible from-scratch scene.

retained_milestone_parent.role: Pre-visible-rim parent, not a substitute for the required retained master

source_lineage.earlier_checkpoints: ../weather-hybrid-v7/ and ../weather-optical-contact-checkpoint-20261008/ remain retained; their master files are different inputs

retained_scene.scope: Keep retained Ball identity, straight coaxial shaft/eight gores, wet PVC materials, world/camera/lighting, ground/receiver and all non-primary-water state. Do not rescale master based on Blender unit scale.

motion_recipe.mechanism: Continuously evaluated vertex coordinates and volume-conserving necking; split closed shells at unchanged boundary coordinates; only afterward gradual rounding and gravity. Daughter retired only after leaving the crop above the ground. Small rim remnant stays.
motion_recipe.water_geometry_fixture: Original 74,809-byte NPZ is not shipped; Water(audit=True) regenerates arrays from the exact master. No source/reference image or binary fixture is published.

processing.denoise: OIDN 2.5.1 HDR/high CPU. Hero uses actual same-buffer albedo/normal; catcher is color-only. Original hero alpha and untouched plate are retained.
processing.display: AgX / AgX - Medium High Contrast, exposure 0, gamma 1, applied once
processing.encoding: ffmpeg libx264 CRF8/yuv420p, 75 frames. Actual MP4s decoded and probed in original proof. No audio; labeled 5x nearest-neighbour copy and decoded contact-sheet code included.

boundaries: No airborne rain or UI added
No arbitrary-camera or fully reactive visible-terrain claim
publication_exclusions: Packed masters and ancestor scene files
Private QA reports, logs and process metadata
Private artifact identifiers or signed URLs
Product code, versions, backend, frontend and CI changes

validation_boundary.source_checks: Python AST, exact-function/class preservation, UTF-8/file inventory/SHA-256, public privacy scan, small numpy/contract tests and dry-run command plans; exact-commit remote CI checked separately
